[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30847552/dc777512626917efdeeb1bf9cc55a7acca8313be.jpg[/img]

We are thrilled to announce that [b]from today until February 7th[/b] the second public playtests for The Whims of the Gods are available on its Steam page!

This strategic, cooperative city-builder invites you and your friend to construct and defend an ancient city together. Experience unique co-op gameplay, manage resources, and face challenges sent by whimsical deities.

[b]How to do it in a few simple steps?[/b]
[list]
[*] go to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642390/The_Whims_of_the_Gods/]Steam The Whims of the Gods tab[/url] 
[*] click the "REQUEST ACCESS" button or...
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/FBBczkkFtr]join our community on Discord[/url], select the emoji 🎮 accepting our rules, and tag our admins there so that they can give you a key to the game
[/list]
[b]Your feedback is invaluable to us as we refine the game ahead of its release. You can:[/b] 
[list]
[*] leave it on the Steam tab in discussions ([b]this particular thread is visible only to accounts that receive the game code![/b]) or 
[*] on the appropriate, playtest-dedicated channel on our Discord
[/list]
We look forward to hearing your thoughts. Let's create the best possible city-builder game in the world together!

notes.title: Legendary actor joins My Memory of Us and reveals the final release date!
notes.content:
[b]Hi Gamers,[/b]

We can officially announce that [b]My Memory of Us[/b] launches [b]October 9, 2018 on PC, PlayStation®4 and Xbox One[/b]! Additionally, our game will feature the golden voice of legendary actor of stage and screen, [b]Patrick Stewart[/b].

[b]My Memory of Us[/b] is a puzzle-based, side-scrolling story game of hope and heroism in the face of absolute terror. Story, narrated by [b]Patrick Stewart[/b] begins in [b]The City[/b] - a place inspired by [b]pre-Second World War Warsaw[/b], where a young boy and girl from two different worlds come together to be kids, free to play and enjoy life. War breaks out and the children, faced with forced separation, with your help, may find a way to stay together and  survive the threat of the evil occupation of their world.  

[i]“The story of My Memory of Us is a personal one to us, as our grandparents faced similar oppression World War II. This game is our ode to  them and the millions of others who lived and died during this time,”[/i] said [b]Mikołaj Pawłowski, CEO, Juggler Games[/b]. [i]“So when it came time to cast a  narrator, Patrick Stewart was the perfect choice. His amazing acting career spans nearly six decades, and since the very beginning he has produced incredible and emotional work. His talent and skill provides the right mixture of gravitas and hope, and his performance resonates perfectly with our game.” [/i]

[b]Patrick Stewart’s[/b] illustrious career has produced unforgettable performances from his award-winning roles with the Royal Shakespeare Company to his work as [b]Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation and as Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men film series[/b]. [b]My Memory of Us[/b] marks his return to the video game format, having previously lent his voice acting talents to titles that include [b]The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion. [/b]

[b]Youtube Patrick Stewart Video Trailer:[/b] https://youtu.be/di18oL5oCic
[h1]My Memory of Us Features:[/h1]
[list][*]A moving story about friendship and love in dangerous times	
[*]Beautiful, sketch-like graphics inspired by naïve art 
[*]Pair mechanics: take control of two separate? characters with different skills and abilities, or control them as a pair 
[*]A grotesque tale mixed with bittersweet humor  
[*]The events shown in the game are based on actual stories from war  
[*]A dialogue system built around the language of symbolic pictures  
[*]Various logical puzzles in 2.5D  
[*]A story that offers deeper meaning, set in historical realities
[*]SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS: Windows 10[/list]

[b]We can't wait to show you the full game,[/b]
[i]Juggler Games and IMGN.PRO[/i]
